brand.name: Bondhon
brand.tagline: A doctor on video, from your phone.

home.heroTitle: See a doctor today, without the waiting room.
home.heroBody: Sign in with your mobile number, pick a doctor who is online, pay securely, and start the video visit. Built for Bangladesh.
home.step1Body: Browse doctors by specialty and see who is online right now.
home.step2Body: Pay the visit fee with bKash, Nagad, card or bank through SSLCommerz.
home.step3Body: Join from your phone or laptop. No app to install.
home.demoBody: Sign in codes are shown on screen instead of sent by SMS, payments run on the SSLCommerz sandbox, and the data resets every night.

doctors.subtitle: Every doctor here holds a video visit through Bondhon.
doctors.bookOffline: This doctor is offline. Booking opens when they come online.
doctors.aboutBody: A visit is a private video call of about 15 to 30 minutes. Pay after booking; the call button appears once the doctor is ready.
